verdict.rationale: Metorial documents an activity/logging layer (traces, sessions, tool calls, auth events, failures) and an Agents area explicitly meant to 'investigate a tool call, review a session, or check how an agent connected,' which covers auditing intent. However, there's no evidence of a detailed replay mechanism, immutable/exportable audit log, or granular per-call payload capture that would let a platform-engineer fully reconstruct/replay an agent's actions. missing for 10: concrete detail on log schema/fields captured per tool call, replay functionality, log export/retention/integrity guarantees, independent confirmation of audit completeness.
